results.title: Three cancers that should never be poked (biopsied)
results.description: Health experts have cautioned that biopsy may carry risks in certain suspected cancers, potentially spreading malignant cells. Dr Priyam Bordoloi highlighted testicular cancer, Wilms tumour in children and ovarian cancer as cases requiring careful diagnostic approaches, with treatment decisions guided by specialists
